title: No Form 16 Yet? File Your ITR Before 31st July Deadline
description: Form 16 is a consolidated certificate from your employer that simplifies filing your Income Tax Return (ITR), but it is not the only document required. Salari.

faq.q: Can I file ITR without Form 16?
faq.a: Yes, absolutely. While Form 16 simplifies the process, it is not legally mandatory. You can file your ITR by collecting information from other documents like payslips, bank statements, Form 26AS, AIS, and investment proofs.

faq.q: What if my employer doesn't issue Form 16?
faq.a: Your employer is legally obligated to issue Form 16 if they have deducted TDS from your salary. If they fail to do so, you can report it to the Income Tax Department. However, for filing purposes, you can proceed by compiling details from your payslips, bank statements, and Form 26AS/AIS.

faq.q: How do I verify my TDS without Form 16?
faq.a: You can verify all TDS deducted against your PAN by downloading Form 26AS and the Annual Information Statement (AIS) from the Income Tax e-filing portal. These documents provide a comprehensive record of all tax deducted and deposited by various entities.

faq.q: What are the risks of filing without Form 16?
faq.a: The primary risk is inaccurate reporting if you do not meticulously reconcile all your income and deductions. This can lead to discrepancies with the Income Tax Department's records, potentially resulting in notices, penalties, or interest for underpaid tax.

faq.q: Is it mandatory to wait for Form 16 if I have all other documents?
faq.a: No, it is not mandatory to wait. If you have all the necessary documents like payslips, bank statements, Form 26AS, AIS, and investment proofs, and you can accurately calculate your income and tax liability, you should proceed with filing your ITR before the deadline.

faq.q: What if there's a mismatch between my calculations and Form 26AS?
faq.a: If there's a mismatch, first re-check your calculations. If the discrepancy persists, contact your employer or the deductor to understand the reason and request a correction. It is generally advisable to file your ITR based on the figures available in Form 26AS/AIS to avoid immediate notices from the tax department.

faq.q: Can I claim HRA without Form 16?
faq.a: Yes, you can claim HRA exemption without Form 16. You will need your rent receipts, proof of rent payment (bank statements), and your landlord's PAN if the annual rent paid exceeds ₹1 lakh. You will calculate the eligible exemption based on income tax rules and declare it in your ITR.
